Data from T. Schettini Gherardini, An explicit mono-monostatic polyhedron (2026 preprint), MIT license.
https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07827
https://github.com/Tancredi-Schettini-Gherardini/certified_gomboc
polytope.npz defines the exact rational halfspaces. body.bin retains all float64 vertices and adjacency for numerical contacts.
Its smaller display hull is an explicit visual approximation, with no equilibrium claim for that display hull.
Reproduce packaging with scripts/build-gomboc.py SOURCE_CHECKOUT COMPLETED_CERTIFICATE_DIRECTORY.
